repo-neighborhoods-65c45686.name: Repo neighborhoods
repo-neighborhoods-65c45686.description: A map of the repo's major neighborhoods — API, backends, native code, tests, docs, and build tooling.
repo-neighborhoods-65c45686.prompt: Classify each file into the repo neighborhood it belongs to: Python API for public plotting/toolkit modules users import; Backends for per-target rendering backend implementations and their GUI shells; Native ext for C/C++/ObjC extension source and vendored native libs; Tests for test modules, fixtures, and baseline images; Docs & demos for prose docs, API reference, and gallery examples; Build & CI for packaging, dependency pins, CI config, and dev tooling.

facets.label: Python API
facets.description: Public plotting modules and toolkits users import directly (e.g. pyplot, axes, figure, artist, collections, mpl_toolkits) — the core Python-level user-facing API.

facets.label: Backends
facets.description: Per-output-target rendering backends and their GUI shells (e.g. backend_agg.py, backend_gtk*, backend_qt*, backend_pdf, backend_svg, backend_macosx.py).

facets.label: Native ext
facets.description: C/C++/Objective-C extension sources and vendored native libraries (src/, extern/, and the stub companions for compiled extension modules).

facets.label: Tests
facets.description: Test modules, fixtures, baseline images, and testing utilities (lib/matplotlib/tests/, lib/matplotlib/testing/, result_images/).

facets.label: Docs & demos
facets.description: Prose documentation, API reference, and gallery example scripts (doc/, galleries/).

facets.label: Build & CI
facets.description: Packaging, dependency pins, CI configuration, and dev tooling (setup.py, setupext.py, pyproject.toml, requirements/, ci/, tools/, azure-pipelines.yml, tox.ini, environment.yml).

rendering-pipeline-1965d97a.name: Rendering pipeline
rendering-pipeline-1965d97a.description: Traces how a plotting call becomes rendered output — from artist objects through layout, the renderer abstraction, backends, native rasterization, and config.
rendering-pipeline-1965d97a.prompt: Classify each file by its role in turning a plotting call into rendered output: Artists for drawable objects that render themselves (text, lines, patches, collections, images); Layout for coordinate transforms, axes/axis geometry, figure composition, and layout engines; Renderer API for the abstract renderer/graphics-context interfaces every backend implements; Backends for concrete backend implementations (raster, vector, GUI, web); Rasterizer for native rasterization and font-rendering code beneath the Python backends; Config for rcParam definitions, style sheets, and packaged defaults.

facets.label: Artists
facets.description: Drawable objects that render themselves: text, lines, patches, collections, images, and the base Artist machinery (artist.py, lines.py, patches.py, collections.py, text.py, image.py, textpath.py).

facets.label: Layout
facets.description: Coordinate transforms, axes and axis geometry, figure composition, and layout engines (transforms.py, axes/, axis.py, figure.py, gridspec.py, layout_engine.py, _tight_layout.py, _constrained_layout.py).

facets.label: Renderer API
facets.description: The abstract renderer and graphics-context interfaces every backend implements (backend_bases.py, backend_managers.py).

facets.label: Backends
facets.description: Concrete backend implementations for raster, vector, GUI, and web targets (backends/backend_agg.py, backend_svg.py, backend_pdf.py, backend_gtk*, backend_qt*, backend_wx*, backend_webagg*, etc.).

facets.label: Rasterizer
facets.description: Native rasterization and font rendering beneath the Python backends (src/_backend_agg*, src/ft2font*, src/_image_resample.h, src/_tkagg.cpp, extern/agg24-svn).

facets.label: Config
facets.description: rcParam definitions, style sheets, and packaged defaults (_fontconfig_pattern.py, style/core.py, mpl-data/stylelib, mpl-data/matplotlibrc, mpl-data/fonts).
